name: Benny
role: Fence at the Ironworks chop shop
welcomeText: Benny Lutz here. Pick up ringing payphones for work. Once a crew trusts you, they’ll call you direct. Got a hot car? Bring it to my chop shop at Ironworks. Keep my number.
about: Fast, friendly, a salesman who's always half-pitching. Plain American.

say: You don't know me, but word travels fast around here you know
And the word is you're new, you're broke, and you can drive.
intro.tone: big warm hello, grinning; rattling off what he knows

male: Listen, ain't nobody in this town gonna call your cell until they trust you.
Till then, you hear a payphone ringing out on the street, don't walk past it.
female: Listen, ain't nobody in this town gonna call your cell until they trust you.
Till then, you hear a payphone ringing out on the street, don't walk past it.
intro.tone: breezy brush-off, then leaning in with a tip

say: anything nice you happen to drive off with,
Stop by my shop, and we both do alright.
intro.tone: mock-innocent, then cheerfully honest; signs off warm

say: Well, that didn't go as planned, did it?
Boss man won't be too happy, ehhh...
Just make sure you do better on the next one.
fail.tone: rueful chuckle; shrugging it off, then a friendly nudge

say: Look, you really fucked that one up.
But if you want more work, you better get your shit together.
fail.tone: blunt, then easy-going; a real warning at the end

say: After that little shit show you just put on, I don't know why the boss keeps you around.
Must be something about you that I ain't seein'...
But I guess that's why he's the boss, huh?
fail.tone: exasperated, then grudging; leaning hard on the last word

say: Call me back if you want another job.
We got a real nice one for you.
Call me back if you want another job.

Boss needs something taken care of.
Ain't gonna discuss the details with you here.
Hit the payphones and you'll know all you need to know.
You know the feds got ears on us, right?
Find you a nice payphone somewhere and we'll fill you in.
Shit, you sure got some balls, don't you?
Calling me after all the shit that went down...
